additional_considerations.rationale: Testing is indicated given his STD history and unprotected sex with multiple partners, but HIV is very unlikely to explain his depression.

source_issues: Parser merge in p034: the STD-history question ('Do you have any history of sexually transmitted diseases?') has no answer in the raw sheet and was merged with the drug-allergy question; the 'No.' answers drug allergies. Annotated as no drug allergies (f050); the STD question is left unanswered, and p021 describes a treated urinary infection 5 months ago.

Parser merge in p030: three doctor utterances (confidentiality preamble, 'Are you currently sexually active?', 'Are you in a relationship at the moment?') share one answer about the girlfriend. Sexual activity is not stated directly; only the relationship (f046) and avoiding condoms with the girlfriend (f048) are recorded.
Age conflict: the opening scenario says 50 years old; the raw Patient Description and the note HPI say 46. demographics.age uses the opening scenario (50).
Name conflict: the opening scenario says 'Gary Mibshell', the sample closure says 'Mr. Mitchell'. demographics keeps the opening-scenario name.
Gold rank 1 cites 'Early awakening', but the script describes awakenings during the night from nightmares (p004), not early-morning waking.
Alcohol: script p025 says two or three beers a month; the note says two beers per month.
The note says 'unprotected sex with multiple female partners'; the script does not give the partners' sex or their number in the past 6 months (p033).
The note PMH says 'urethritis (possibly chlamydia)'; the patient remembers only that the diagnosis started with C (p021). Patient facts keep his wording.
annotator_notes: p004 is split into six facts (no trouble falling asleep, nightmare awakenings, reliving the accident, terror and helplessness, several awakenings, daytime tiredness); daytime tiredness is merged with p007 (f010).
p008 and p011 both say he cannot concentrate on his work; merged into f014. Lack of energy for work is a separate functional fact (f017).
p006 'I don't know. It was an accident.' is recorded as uncertainty about guilt (f013, flagged), not as a denial; 'I tried to help my friend, but I couldn't' is added to the accident fact f003.
p010 only reports pacing when nervous; he does not answer the slowing question. The slow speech and movement are observable signs (note exam x003; SP acting note).
Sad look, slow speech and movement, and yawning are SP demeanor instructions; kept as acting notes only, in line with the worked example.
p027 'One pack a day for 25 years' answers 'Do you smoke cigarettes?' in the present tense, so smoking is marked current.
